reason: A DSH plugin that monitors DeepSeek account balance and calculates current-session usage costs using the official balance API and session logs, then displays the results in the web interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并根据会话用量计算和展示本次会话消费金额。
summaries.en: Displays the DeepSeek account balance in the DSH web interface and calculates and shows the current session’s estimated cost from session usage.

capabilities: Resolves the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential from the host credential sources
Calls the DeepSeek balance API through a host subprocess
Reads session logs to aggregate model token usage
Exposes balance and usage data through a local web endpoint
Displays and refreshes account balance and session cost data in the web interface
